environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service consuming from the same SQS queue. However, messages originate from an external-facing API Gateway (REST API, not HTTP API) with a request validator attached to the POST /notifications method. The validator uses a Model schema (JSON Schema draft-04) that enforces 'pattern' constraints on all string fields. The model defines recipient_name with pattern '^[\\w\\s.\\-]{1,64}$', subject with pattern '^[\\w\\s!?.,:;\\-]{1,256}$', notification_type with enum constraint ['alert','digest','reminder','welcome'], and tracking_id with pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-]{8,36}$'. The request validator is configured with validateRequestBody=true. Messages failing validation receive 400 and are never published to SQS. Note: the API Gateway resource policy restricts invoke access to a specific VPC endpoint, and CloudWatch logs show ~2% of requests rejected by the validator monthly.

config.queue: SQS Standard Queue with no content-based deduplication
config.message_source: API Gateway (REST) -> SQS Integration (direct, no Lambda proxy)
config.network: API Gateway with VPC endpoint policy, private integration to SQS
config.authentication: API key + IAM SigV4 for API Gateway invoke
